neighbours.label: The verb 'decide' (decided, decide) and Chinese 决定
fire: After a long talk we decided to move abroad.
The school board decided that the rule should stay.
You have to decide what matters most.
The committee decided against a new hall.
I finally decided to quit smoking.
Their father decided on a small wedding.
quiet: After a long talk we agreed to move abroad.
The school board voted that the rule should stay.
You have to know what matters most.
The committee argued against a new hall.
I finally tried to quit smoking.
Their father paid for a small wedding.

predictions: 'decide' fires; other verbs of agreeing and choosing stay quiet. ' determined' also fired in probes but is outside this label.
